payload.blocks: Every land on main, including this plan's phase-table update (ticket c-31609-1795404621698) and every other lead's land.
payload.headline: Run fgos git recover: a stuck land since 09:14 blocks every land on main (resource-recovery-required)

parts.cause: fgos git status lists the pending Land operation land-3689269-1795400075015143607-2 (writer 3689246), which started at about 09:14 and never finished, plus three older pending RefDelete and RemoteTransfer operations. The land door's refusal table says to ask the owner to run fgos git recover.

options.does: The owner (or the supervisor, if granted) runs fgos git recover in /home/vantt/projects/forgent. It settles the stuck land and frees the merge slot.
options.harm: The recovery decides the fate of the stuck land. Its writer's branch may need landing again.
options.label: A. Run fgos git recover now

options.does: Leave the operation alone, in case its writer is still alive and completes.
options.harm: The writer has not finished in over an hour, and the door already says recovery is required, so lands stay blocked.
options.label: B. Wait for the writer to finish

parts.recommendation: A: the door names recovery explicitly, and the operation has been stuck for more than an hour.

scope.allows: Running fgos git recover once on the main checkout.
scope.forbids: Hand-editing refs, the journal or the census, and changing any plan.

parts.what: From 09:16 to 10:30 every land of this lead was refused, first with merge-slot-busy and now with resource-recovery-required at 'fast-forward main'. The plan file update parking phase 1 is ready but cannot land.
